column1: # expectedSource must match the string produced by Sources.format, or a prefix of it:
#   CSV  -> "warehouse_inventory.csv (fila 1)"   the row IS the answer, so demand the row
#   PDF  -> "orbital_station_handbook.pdf"       the page bridge may legitimately move the
#                                                answer between pages, so do not demand a page
# ALTERNATIVES: several sources separated by '|' are all correct, and the best rank among them
# counts. This is not a convenience: the corpus contains genuine duplicates (every product in
# inventario_supermercado_masivo.csv appears twice with different brands, and the two space
# manuals cover the same procedures in two languages), so a single expected source would score
# a CORRECT retrieval as a miss. See RetrievalBenchmarkTest.rankOf.
# kind = "abstention" means NOTHING should be retrieved: the answer is not in the corpus.
# These rows are scored apart and never enter hit@3 or MRR — see the benchmark.
# Corpus: 16 documents. 3 CSV, 6 TXT, 7 PDF. Spanish and English.
